prompt:
Create a faithful generated game asset for Small Leech, exact incarnation Resident Evil Outbreak (2003). Use the attached verified references only. Preserve the precise head, anatomy, proportions, costume, equipment, material colours and asymmetric details. Do not mix games, phases or editions. Match the source appearance without added cartoon outlines, coloured halos or decoration. One subject only, no text, labels, scenery, floor, montage or frame. Clean transparent alpha. This remains a generated adaptation, not an original Capcom frame or a geometric 1:1 certificate. One complete full-body static combat idle base pose, facing right in a side/three-quarter fighting-game view. Keep every source-documented limb, foot, tail, wing, tentacle, horn and equipment inside the image with generous transparent padding. Preserve actual locomotion and support points; do not turn a quadruped or aquatic creature into a humanoid. Produce the entire body in this one image, not separate pieces. No motion blur, duplicate bodies or animation-frame grid. Only proceed after actually reviewing a complete source body reference.
Preserve the complete smooth dark curved leech, rounded sucker end and tapered opposite tail. A slight crawling ready curve with the rounded sucker/anterior end to RIGHT and tail LEFT. No invented eyes, claws, arms, legs or monster teeth.
Composition: at least ten percent clear transparent padding around every body, wing, foot, tail and equipment endpoint. One complete boss entry in ONE image, clear rightward presentation; no animation grid, scenery, labels or added coloured halo. Preserve real anatomical asymmetries; no software mirror.
sourceObservation: Entire curved tapered dark leech with rounded sucker end and pointed opposite end inside frame; smooth invertebrate body has no limbs or separate head features.
